license_required.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

issuing_authority.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
issuing_authority.quote: Department means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation

name.quote: There is hereby created the Illinois State Medical Board

type.quote: The Medical Board shall consist of 17 members... Eight members shall be physicians licensed to practice medicine in all of its branches in Illinois possessing the degree of doctor of medicine. Two members shall be physicians licensed to practice medicine in all its branches in Illinois possessing the degree of doctor of osteopathy or osteopathic medicine... Two members shall be chiropractic physicians licensed to practice in Illinois... Two members shall be physician assistants licensed to practice in Illinois. Three members shall be members of the public

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: Department means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation

moral_character_required.quote: is of good moral character. In determining moral character under this Section, the Department may take into consideration whether the applicant has engaged in conduct or activities which would constitute grounds for discipline under this Act

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy/Osteopathic Medicine
degree_required.quote: that the applicant is a graduate of a medical or osteopathic college in the United States, its territories or Canada

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education or Bureau of Professional Education of the American Osteopathic Association
accrediting_body.quote: a medical or osteopathic college approved by the Department or by a private, not for profit accrediting body approved by the Department

required.quote: in addition thereto, a course of postgraduate clinical training of not less than 12 months as approved by the Department

duration.value: 12 months minimum for US/Canadian graduates; 24 months for certain foreign graduates
duration.quote: a course of postgraduate clinical training of not less than 12 months as approved by the Department

kind.quote: a course of postgraduate clinical training of not less than 12 months as approved by the Department

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.quote: If an applicant fails to pass an examination for a license under this Act within 3 years after filing their application, the application shall be denied

interval_years.quote: The expiration date and renewal period for each license issued under this Act shall be set by rule

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Beginning on January 1, 2020, the fee for renewal of a license for a resident or nonresident is $181 per year

required.quote: The Department shall promulgate rules of continuing education for persons licensed under this Act that require an average of 50 hours of continuing education per license year

hours_per_period.quote: require an average of 50 hours of continuing education per license year

period_years.quote: require an average of 50 hours of continuing education per license year

available.quote: The Department may, in its discretion, issue a license by endorsement to any person who is currently licensed to practice medicine in all of its branches, or a chiropractic physician, in any other state, territory, country or province

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another jurisdiction, meet educational requirements substantially equivalent to Illinois standards, be of good moral character, and be physically and mentally capable of practicing medicine
requirements.quote: That the applicant is of good moral character... That the applicant is physically, mentally and professionally capable of practicing medicine with reasonable judgment, skill and safety... the requirements for a license to practice medicine in all of its branches in the particular state, territory, country or province in which the applicant is licensed are deemed by the Department to have been substantially equivalent to the requirements for a license to practice medicine in all of its branches in force in this State

exists.quote: The Medical Board shall consist of 17 members, to be appointed by the Governor by and with the advice and consent of the Senate

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

credential_type.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

title_protection.quote: holds himself or herself out to the public as being engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of physical or mental ailments or conditions including, but not limited to, deformities, diseases, disorders, or injuries of human beings... or attaches the title Doctor, Physician, Surgeon, M.D., D.O. or D.C. or any other word or abbreviation to his or her name indicating that he or she is engaged in the treatment of human ailments or conditions as a business

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice medicine, or any of its branches, or treat human ailments without the use of drugs and without operative surgery, without a valid, active license to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or sentencing, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States of any crime that is a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in practice under this Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in obtaining or renewing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for, or procuring, a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances resulting in inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, of alcohol, or of any other substances which results in the inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or, except as provided by law, an assumed name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements about skill or efficacy of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading statement regarding their skill or the efficacy or value of the medicine, treatment, or remedy prescribed by them at their direction in the treatment of any disease or other condition of the body or mind

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing another person or organization to use their license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing another person or organization to use their license, procured under this Act, to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse action taken by another state or jurisdiction against a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adverse action taken by another state or jurisdiction against a license or other authorization to practice as a medical doctor, doctor of osteopathy, doctor of osteopathic medicine, or doctor of chiropractic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the Medical Practice Act or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this Act or of the Medical Practice Act prior to the repeal of that Act, or violation of the rules, or a final administrative action of the Secretary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of prohibition against fee splitting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the prohibition against fee splitting in Section 22.2 of this Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of probationary status or conditions or restrictions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Medical Board that the registrant after having his or her license placed on probationary status or subjected to conditions or restrictions violated the terms of the probation or failed to comply with such terms or conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, or self-administering controlled substances for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, giving, or self-administering any drug classified as a controlled substance (designated product) or narcotic for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion of sale of drugs, devices, or goods in manner exploiting patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a patient in such manner as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure or treat disease by secret method or refusing to divulge treatment method
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine, or the treating, operating, or prescribing for any human condition by a method, means, or procedure which the licensee refuses to divulge upon demand of the Department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct including sexual misconduct related to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in the commission of any act including, but not limited to, commission of an act of sexual misconduct related to the licensee's practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in his or her practice as a physician, including, but not limited to, false records to support claims against the medical assistance program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful omission to file or record medical reports or failure to report suspected abuse or neglect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful omission to file or record, or willfully impeding the filing or recording, or inducing another person to omit to file or record, medical reports as required by law, or willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse or neglect as required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as perpetrator in indicated report of child abuse or neglect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services under the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of professional patronage by corporation or agents or profiting from agents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of professional patronage by any corporation, agents, or persons, or profiting from those representing themselves to be agents of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross and willful continued overcharging for professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross and willful and continued overcharging for professional services, including filing false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of practice demonstrating incapacity or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of practice or other behavior which demonstrates incapacity or incompetence to practice under this Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental illness or disability resulting in inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental illness or disability which results in the inability to practice under this Act with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical illness or loss of motor skill resulting in inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skill which results in a physician's inability to practice under this Act with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert licensing examinations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examinations administered under this Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently violating physician-patient confidentiality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between physician and patient except as required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in practice documents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with practice under this Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding and abetting unlicensed practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding and abetting an individual not licensed under this Act in the practice of a profession licensed under this Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating state or federal laws relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating State or federal laws or regulations relating to controlled substances, legend drugs, or ephedra

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse action taken by another licensing jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the Department any adverse final action taken against them by another licensing jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report surrender of license while under disciplinary investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the Department surrender of a license or authorization to practice as a medical doctor, a doctor of osteopathy, a doctor of osteopathic medicine, or doctor of chiropractic in another state or jurisdiction, or surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society, while under disciplinary investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse judgment, settlement, or award from liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the Department any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide copies of medical records as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide copies of medical records as required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish Department with legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the Department, its investigators or representatives, relevant information, legally requested by the Department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required by this law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into excessive number of collaborative agreements with advanced practice registered nurses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into an excessive number of written collaborative agreements with licensed advanced practice registered nurses resulting in an inability to adequately collaborate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with advanced practice registered nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with a licensed advanced practice registered nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Compassionate Use of Medical Cannabis Program Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the Compassionate Use of Medical Cannabis Program Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into excessive number of collaborative agreements with prescribing psychologists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into an excessive number of written collaborative agreements with licensed prescribing psychologists resulting in an inability to adequately collaborate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with prescribing psychologist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with a licensed prescribing psychologist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation of eligible adult
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult as defined in and required by the Adult Protective Services Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as abuser in verified report of adult abuse or neglect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as an abuser in a verified report by the Department on Aging under the Adult Protective Services Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee abused, neglected, or financially exploited an eligible adult

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into excessive number of collaborative agreements with physician assistants
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into an excessive number of written collaborative agreements with licensed physician assistants resulting in an inability to adequately collaborate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with physician assistant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated failure to adequately collaborate with a physician assistant

methods_authorized.quote: practice medicine in all of its branches

drug_authority.value: Physicians licensed to practice medicine in all of its branches may purchase and dispense legend drugs
drug_authority.quote: Any person licensed under this Act to practice medicine in all of its branches shall be authorized to purchase legend drugs requiring an order of a person authorized to prescribe drugs, and to dispense such legend drugs in the regular course of practicing medicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical graduates must have education certified by Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates, pass USMLE Steps 1, 2 CK, and 3, maintain unencumbered license from another country, and not be licensed in any US state or territory
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: International medical graduate means a medical graduate (i) who has been trained in a country other than the United States; (ii) whose education has been certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates; (iii) who has passed Step 1, Step 2 Clinical Knowledge, and Step 3 of the United States Medical Licensing Examination as required by this Act; (iv) who maintains an unencumbered license from another country; and (v) who is not licensed to practice medicine in any state or territory of the United States

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: a course of postgraduate clinical training of not less than 12 months as approved by the Department

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Telemedicine is defined as performance of activities including rendering written or oral opinions concerning diagnosis or treatment of a patient in Illinois by a person in a different location than the patient. Out-of-state persons providing services through telemedicine submit to Illinois jurisdiction
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: telemedicine means the performance of any of the activities listed in Section 49, including, but not limited to, rendering written or oral opinions concerning diagnosis or treatment of a patient in Illinois by a person in a different location than the patient as a result of transmission of individual patient data by telephonic, electronic, or other means of communication

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A person with a temporary permit for health care may treat a patient located in this State through telehealth services in a manner consistent with the person's scope of practice and agreement with a sponsoring entity

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician licensed to practice medicine in all its branches may enter into collaborative agreements with no more than 7 full-time equivalent physician assistants, except in a hospital, hospital affiliate, or ambulatory surgical treatment center

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every insurance company which offers policies of professional liability insurance to persons licensed under this Act... shall report to the Medical Board the settlement of any claim or cause of action, or final judgment rendered in any cause of action, which alleged negligence in the furnishing of medical care by such licensed person when such settlement or final judgment is in favor of the plaintiff

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The chief administrator or executive officer of any health care institution licensed by the Illinois Department of Public Health shall report to the Medical Board when any person's clinical privileges are terminated or are restricted based on a final determination

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The Medical Board shall, by rule, provide for the reporting to it by health care institutions of all instances in which a person, licensed under this Act, who is impaired by reason of age, drug or alcohol abuse or physical or mental impairment, is under supervision and, where appropriate, is in a program of rehabilitation

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In enforcing this Section, the Medical Board, upon a showing of a possible violation, may compel any individual who is licensed to practice under this Act or holds a permit to practice under this Act, or any individual who has applied for licensure or a permit pursuant to this Act, to submit to a mental or physical examination and evaluation, or both

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A physician who holds an active license in another state or a second year resident enrolled in a residency program accredited by the Liaison Committee on Graduate Medical Education or the Bureau of Professional Education of the American Osteopathic Association may provide medical services to patients in Illinois during a bonafide emergency in immediate preparation for or during interstate transit

investigational_drug_protection.quote: The Department shall not revoke, suspend, place on probation, reprimand, refuse to issue or renew, or take any other disciplinary or non-disciplinary action against the license or permit issued under this Act to practice medicine to a physician: (1) based solely upon the recommendation of the physician to an eligible patient regarding, or prescription for, or treatment with, an investigational drug, biological product, or device
